prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most kinds of changes (adoption new_flow, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, finish copy, finish hint, finish redesign, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (3 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with two tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, copy: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -4.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Carousel Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen layout into a interactive visual carousel showcasing pet styles. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating user indecision during path selection.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Check: Add clear loading status copy and explicit rendering checks to the waiting screen. (why: Users wait a median 201s on home and support received 3 emails reporting pets failing to display on the desktop.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Controls Intro: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist demonstrating how to move, hide, and interact with the pet. (why: Finish stage drops off to 64.8% and support received multiple post-onboarding emails asking how to control or hide pets.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Decision Action Copy: Update story screen headline and button text to clearly state what choosing a pet companion path entails. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is unusually high at 514s compared to the 8s median.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Failure Recovery Alert: Provide a delayed hint notification offering quick troubleshooting if authentication stalls. (why: Support received 2 bug reports where the sign-in screen stalled or failed to display.)
5: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a split layout displaying pet stats alongside naming input. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (66.2% conversion, 1017s mean time) and needs a clearer, structured confirmation step.)
6: [home, incentive] Desktop Readiness Reward Badge: Display a playful completion badge component on the waiting screen while background loading completes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s; adding visual achievement cues maintains engagement.)
7: [finish, hint] Tray Menu Quick Reference Tip: Add a prominent hint box on the home intro screen explaining system tray controls. (why: Post-onboarding support emails show user confusion regarding how to talk to, hide, or manage desktop pets.)
